tasks.label: Zip current file's directory
tasks.command: mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/build" && cd "${fileDirname}" && rm -f "${workspaceFolder}/build/${fileDirnameBasename}.zip" && zip -r "${workspaceFolder}/build/${fileDirnameBasename}.zip" . -x "build/*" -x "*/build/*" && grep -qxF 'build/' "${workspaceFolder}/.gitignore" 2>/dev/null || echo 'build/' >> "${workspaceFolder}/.gitignore"
